strpres_helpful.label: president acting without regard to Congress and the courts would be HELPFUL (7-point summary, codes 1-3 = helpful)

strleader_agree.label: agrees a strong leader is good for the US even if the leader bends the rules

prefer_democracy.label: agrees democracy is preferable to any other kind of government (CSES6, 2024 only)

courts_authority.label: agrees the courts should be able to stop the government acting beyond its authority (CSES6 Q04B, 2024 only)

people_decide.label: agrees the people, not politicians, should make the most important policy decisions (CSES5, 2020 only)

votes_counted_fairly.label: votes are counted fairly all or most of the time

violence_justified.label: political violence is at least 'a little' justified

satisfied_democracy.label: very or fairly satisfied with the way democracy works in the US

trust_govt.label: trusts the federal government to do what is right always or most of the time

trust_election_officials.label: trusts election officials a great deal or a lot

auth_obedience.label: picks obedience over self-reliance as the more important child quality

auth_respect.label: picks respect for elders over independence

auth_behaved.label: picks well behaved over being considerate

minorities_adapt.label: agrees minorities should adapt to the customs and traditions of the US (CSES5, 2020 only)

born_here_important.label: says being born in the US is very or fairly important to being American
